summary: A batched usage read on a seat's host reads the held usage readings of every subject in one statement, not one per subject, so a cold roster rebuild costs no statement per card for them again

replay.detail: No claim is written or changed. The batched usage read folds the same held response_rollup and context_occupancy readings, in the same order, into the same totals.

schema.detail: No schema change: the read uses the existing local_latest_slots and local_observations tables.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No claim kind, field, wire, API or CLI shape changes; card and usage answers are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No restart beyond the normal upgrade; no migration or backfill.

recovery.detail: No data recovery is needed; reverting restores the per-subject read.
